sessions.note: CME Globex Sunday-Friday 17:00-16:15 CT with a 45-minute break from 16:15 CT (CL and NG specs, June 2012 captures: 'Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 5:15 p.m. New York time/ET (5:00 p.m. - 4:15 p.m. Chicago Time/CT) with a 45-minute break each day beginning at 5:15 p.m. (4:15 p.m. CT)'); every 2012 per-holiday schedule (Dec 2011 to Dec 2012 updates) states the NYMEX regular close as '1615 CT / 1715 ET' and the regular open as '1700 CT / 1800 ET'. day_session_ct is energy.py's design-D6 row (08:00-13:30 CT), equal to the 2012 NYMEX open-outcry hours 'Monday – Friday 9:00 AM to 2:30 PM (8:00 AM to 1:30 PM CT)'. MCL (listed 2021) and MNG (listed 2023) did not trade in 2012; QM and QG are taken to share the NYMEX energy row, as in energy.py.

year_coverage.unscheduled_check: CME's own list of its 2012 CFTC rule filings (cme_cftc_filings_2012, filings 01/03/12..12/28/12) holds exactly two emergency-action (Rule 257) filings, both Hurricane Sandy: 12-363 (Oct 29) and 12-370 (Oct 30); both read (cftc_cme_sub_12_363, cftc_cme_sub_12_370) with CME Clearing advisories 12-463 and 12-464: NYMEX floor closed Oct 29-30, CME Globex energy available in regular hours, no NYMEX Globex halt. No 2012 national day of mourning or other market-wide closure appears in the CME holiday page (June and November 2012 captures) or in these filings. Limit: CME's weekly Globex notices were not read one by one for technical outages; one cmegroup.com/cftc.gov web search for a 2012 NYMEX Globex outage found none.
